actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA metabolic-suppression identity with 14 significant pathways, stable fused internal structure (ARI 0.79) and positive boundary separation to all other sets, and no set-specific technical confound. Cross-modal membership support is modest but the fused structure is defensible, so this candidate is retained for downstream validation.

C0002 has affirmative but modest biological support (coherent RNA metabolic/xenobiotic up-signature plus a significant DST enrichment with nominal PBRM1/MTOR trends) and no set-specific technical confound. Internal resample stability is only moderate (ARI 0.50) and cross-modal support is weak, so structure remains uncertain, but no available evidence indicates a better-supported revision; retain for downstream validation.

C0003 shows strong cross-modality biological support: a coordinated immune/inflammatory RNA program and marked BAP1 enrichment (q=1.2e-6), with the strongest cross-modal membership support among sets, positive boundary separation, and no set-specific technical confound. Retain for downstream validation.

C0004 has affirmative biological support from a coherent WXS configuration (near-universal VHL mutation with PBRM1/BAP1 depletion) and no set-specific technical confound, but its cross-modal consistency is essentially WXS-only with negative CT/WSI/RNA silhouettes. Structure remains uncertain, yet no available evidence supports a better revision; retain for downstream validation.

C0005 has concordant RNA pathway enrichment and significant PBRM1/VHL mutation enrichment with stable internal structure, but it is the only set with adjusted-significant technical associations (tissue_source_site:BP and ct_scanner_model:LightSpeed16), a plausible competing explanation. No available evidence supports a better-supported revision, so retain with this caveat for downstream validation.

C0006 has affirmative biological support from a coherent WXS pattern of VHL- and PBRM1-wildtype tumors with highly stable internal structure (ARI 1.0) and no set-specific technical confound, but cross-modal consistency is essentially WXS-only with negative CT/WSI/RNA silhouettes. Structure remains uncertain, yet no available evidence supports a better revision; retain for downstream validation.
